geometry_access_audit.scope: Recorded MCP tool names, geometry filenames in read arguments, and geometry references in native command text; indirect paths, external scripts, historical memory and unlogged execution are not covered

notes: The historical DA3 smoke is interrupted and excluded from the 160 valid No task progress episodes.
DA3 only replaces depth for back_project_batch and query_world_map.

E04 now removes only four explicit VLA grasp/contact labels and their wrapper queries. Full native task_progress, geometry, native success, scoring-source access and original memory remain. The older filtered-progress 46/160 run is archived separately.

NoGeomTools removes back_project_batch and query_world_map from registered tools and their prompt instructions; internal depth/world maps, task-progress distances, contact, success, file permissions and historical memory remain.

E06 No task progress and agent success builds on No task progress, hides live success/termination/progress and removes native-success VLA early stopping. The independent evaluator scores the final state after the planner returns; geometry, contact and historical memory remain. Agent declarations are not benchmark scores.

E07 removes historical task/global memory only; current-episode history and baseline feedback remain. Its 41/160 score happens to match E03, a separate setting. Task/seed matching is not proof of identical scenes or causal attribution.

E08 combines geometry-query, historical-memory, progress and contact-feedback removal and blocks scoring-source access. Native success, robot proprioception and controls remain; internal depth/world maps and camera metadata remain saved. It is not an all-ground-truth-free or OS-isolated system.

E08 provides EEF/base pose coordinates to the Planner; E09 withholds them and additional motion, gripper-width, held_apart and execution feedback. Both retain VLA/controller proprioception, native simulator success and native-success early stopping. The 41 versus 27 comparison does not isolate coordinates alone.
E10 uses VLM intermediate progress and retains native success and VLA early stop. Only this 160-episode batch is added, with comparisons to the existing E01 and E03 results.

no_planner_pose.comparison_limit: The 14-success decrease versus E08 is not a pose-only ablation: additional gripper/motion/execution feedback was removed. Separate batches can differ in initial conditions and stochastic actions.

context_audit.scope: Observed RPent tool/file boundary; not an operating-system sandbox. Command inputs and finish declarations are not hidden feedback; MCP transport status/duration are excluded.
context_audit.exception_note: Two final saved records are tool_cancelled markers at planner budget termination; they are not completed normal observation returns.

reliability_audit.scope: Accepted attempts only. Infrastructure-fault attempts are archived and excluded. No logged native error does not prove the absence of silent contention.

initial_comparison.scope: Task text, initial RGB file bytes and retained camera-metadata file bytes only. E09 does not save Planner robot state. Equality of these artifacts does not establish identical simulator initial states or a causal effect.
